title: orm recipe
description: The recipe format of docs/spec/feature-coverage.md (FCV-2 to FCV-4). A recipe with a fixture expects exactly mysql, postgres and sqlite; a recipe without one expects exactly none.

version.description: The version of a recipe that carries its own vector note (tests/dbspec/plan-cases.json).

note.description: The note of a recipe that carries its own vector note (tests/dbspec/plan-cases.json).

fixture.description: A dbspec-set.json document set, or none: the cases of a recipe with fixture none run on an empty case database (FCV-3).

schema.description: The schema manifest that the ir.validate steps check their requests against, relative to the recipe file.

model.description: The model name as the generator spells it, such as CompositeAccount (FCV-4).

install.description: false: the helper installs no fixture before the steps, which install it with schema.install (statement_events).

value.description: A recipe wrapper: one key that names the form of the value.

f64.description: A non-finite binary64 number (the bind vectors of tests/bind/vectors.json); a finite one is a float wrapper.

caseId.description: A case id: a name whose hyphens name the case of a plan vector (tests/dbspec/plan-*.json).

encodeArgument.description: The value of codec.encode: an argument, or an ordered_json wrapper, the ordered-json value of its value whatever the stages (FCV-4).

expect.description: The outcome of each database: exactly mysql, postgres and sqlite, or exactly none; the root selects which.

isolation.description: The isolation level of the transaction; a nested transaction that names one is refused with CONFIG.

read_only.description: A read-only transaction; a nested transaction that names it is refused with CONFIG.

dsn.description: The DSN of the case database for case, otherwise the DSN text of the step (FCV-4).

schema.description: The schema manifest of the request, relative to the recipe file.

input.description: A request of the protocol (docs/spec/protocol.md) without manifest_hash; the step adds the hash of the schema named by schema.

lines.description: A schema text, one string per line (docs/spec/dbspec.md).
A plan text, one string per line (docs/spec/plans.md).

source.description: The schema the plan changes; null is the empty schema.

text.description: The plan text of EmitPlan: the lines of the plan, each ended by a newline.

source.description: The schema the plan changes; null is the empty schema.

steps.description: The steps of PlanSteps in order, each the object of docs/spec/plans.md (Steps).

request.description: A request of the protocol (docs/spec/protocol.md) without manifest_hash; the step adds the hash of the schema named by the schema key of the recipe.

chain.description: The case of tests/markdown/cases.json that the chain runs (tests/markdown/README.md).

answer.description: The answer of the chain's one request, as the case gives it (docs/spec/protocol.md section 5, Read).

answers.description: The answers of a transaction chain keyed by the op of each control message and the kind of each request.

bind.description: The bind field of a slot step (FCV-4 ir.answer, T334-3-15-3c): the chain is slot, which writes the value into the column of tests/bind/slots.dbs that the column names and sends the insert. The column gives the type and the precision of the slot.

column.description: A time or datetime column of tests/bind/slots.dbs; its precision is the digit of the name.

value.description: The client value as text, such as 10:00:00.123 or 2024-01-02T03:04:05.5 (PRT-67).
The result of the chain in the plain JSON form of tests/markdown/README.md, a row, a list, a count, a value or {error, runs}.

params.description: The params of the one request that the listener received (PRT-66, PRT-67), in the JSON form of PRT-67; the now of the message is not compared.

lock.description: The row lock of the query; outside a transaction it is refused with CONFIG.

qualifiedName.description: A name, or a dotted name: alias.column of a joined model (FCV-4 query fields) or a dotted local name (utils.set_local).

dsn.description: A DSN: sqlite_file absent names a SQLite file that the case does not create; url is a DSN text that no dialect serves.

only.description: The databases that run a step or a case; a step or a case without it runs on every database.
